note: City of Ortonville campground in Riverside Park on the Minnesota River just below the Big Stone Lake outlet, by the US-12/MN-7 bridge; shore fishing, a fish-cleaning station, and walking distance to a grocery store and downtown. --Claude
summary: City page read: 9 first-come RV spots with electric at $25, 40-ft max, bathrooms, free dump, tent sites on the shore. Imagery: the RV grove looks across ~40 m of open lawn to the river at the fishing dock, behind a thin shore tree strip elsewhere: not waterfront -> riverview suggested. Pin sits on an electrical substation, ~150 m NE of the grove. Phone added; note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront -> riverview (suggested): the RV spots sit in a tree grove at ~45.3025,-96.4505 (campers at its south-west edge ~45.3022,-96.4507). On Esri imagery the Minnesota River here is about 100-130 m wide; between the grove and the water is ~40 m of open mown lawn, then a thin line of shore trees with an open gap at the fishing dock (45.3022,-96.4512), ~45 m from the nearest pads. The pads are unnumbered and sold nightly (first come). The open shore lawn holds the tent sites ('tent sites available along the shore'), which don't earn an RV value. Thin tree line = view, so riverview, not riverfront.
Pin 45.30373,-96.44962 sits on an electrical substation ~150 m NE of the campground grove; move to 45.3025,-96.4505 (under 250 m, but the stored point is not in the campground).
